# Fixtures for `pdf` (PDF document)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. People, places,
companies and addresses (Saltmere, `example.org`, `*.example`) are fictitious.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `log-quartz-aes.pdf` | macOS Core Graphics, AES-128 with an owner password only (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `log-quartz.pdf` | macOS Core Graphics via `scripts/fixtures/documents/quartz_pdf.swift` (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-attached.pdf` | poppler `pdfattach`: `tides.pdf` with a CSV attachment (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-classic.pdf` | Ghostscript `pdfwrite`, classic cross-reference table (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-locked.pdf` | Ghostscript `pdfwrite`, RC4-128 with an owner password only (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.pdf` | Ghostscript `pdfwrite` from `scripts/fixtures/documents/tides.ps` (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
